entities.name: Turhan Përmeti
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Turhan Pasha Përmeti was an Albanian politician and statesman who served as the second prime minister of Albania, serving from March 1914 to September 1914 and from December 1918 to January 1920. He was also in service of the Ottoman state and held the title of Pasha of the Ottoman Empire.
